# Align structures with 32-bit fields to four bytes

Misaligned word access restarted a PEN-F that the emulator had accepted.

**Category:** hazard · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [pen-f firmware 3.1, build 3101](../firmware/pen-f-3101.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus PEN-F](../cameras/pen-f.md)

MN103 needs natural alignment for word and halfword access. Strings may need two-byte alignment; structures with u32 fields need four. Check linked addresses explicitly: emulators may not.

> **What happens:** Camera restart on entering COLOR, while the emulator of the time accepted the reads.

**Symptoms:** [Restarts or crashes when a feature runs](index.md#restart-in-use)

## Observations

- **Physical camera** ([Olympus firmware research](../projects/oly-fw-analysis.md)): A two-byte-aligned UI style restarted the camera on entering COLOR; four-byte alignment fixed it. Source: [Validation reference](../sources/fishcu.validation.md).
